units: USD millions, million shares; per-share amounts USD

reverse_dcf.conditions: Base margin ramp to 12.5%, 11% discount, 2.5% terminal growth, 25% incremental ROIC, same funded-growth floors; not a forecast.

notes: Model is deterministic report support, not a banker formula workbook or technical entry approval.
GAAP-based forecast margins retain SBC, operating lease expense and intangible consumption. No amortization or SBC addback.
Physical DA assumed 1% of revenue, offset by maintenance capex. Growth capex and working capital charged each year and terminal.
Dilution buffer makes current valuation denominator equal to latest quarterly diluted shares; no forecast ASR benefit.

TTM EPS is an approximate FY plus current nine months minus prior nine months calculation across different weighted-share periods; not a quarterly EPS sum or NI/current shares. Current actual quarterly EPS sum is 8.00.
Capex excludes acquisitions; owner_cash_proxy is CFO minus reported capex minus SBC, not FCFF.
timing_convention: Ten full forward annual cash flows discounted at year end; terminal value at end of year 10 using funded year-11 cash flow. September 2026 TTM anchor; no calendar-date stub or partial-year catch-up adjustment.

all_excluded_awards_added_no_exercise_pr.purpose: Harsh dilution sensitivity, not treasury-stock-method estimate; retained SBC means this is not the main model.

conditional_500m_asr_at_reference_price.status: Illustrative only; not an execution assumption
